title: GMUT adiabatic-mode, soft-limit, and gauge-artifact obligation tribunal
hypothesis: A typed synthetic tribunal can reject a claimed cosmological soft-limit relation unless the long-wavelength mode, residual gauge transformation, regularity assumptions, constraint equations, and conserved quantity are stated consistently without treating the relation as an observed GMUT prediction.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate wave-number scaling, gauge generator, regularity, constraint satisfaction, entropy source, anisotropic stress, conserved-variable definition, perturbative order, and promotion language; inconsistent or unsupported relations must fail closed.
evidence_class: bounded structural, proxy, open-gap, or exact-gate software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the frozen software evidence class and cannot promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
